newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez rises after Le Monde article.
newsitem.headline: Suez rises after Le Monde article.

text.p: Shares in Cie de Suez jumped after an article in the Le Monde newspaper suggested that a widely rumoured merger with Lyonnaise des Eaux would take the form of a bid by Lyonnaise for Suez.
Market speculation so far had been that Suez would bid for Lyonnaise.

Suez was up 2.6 percent at 284.50 francs at 1142 GMT while Lyonnaise was up 1.39 percent at 582 francs, down from a high of 586 francs. "We wil hear a lot of different stories on this one before it is over. People are covering themselves for whatever eventuality," a broker said.
Le Monde said that Lyonnaise would have to renegotiate its water distribution contracts with local communities in case of a take-over by Suez, an argument that brokers took with some scepticism.
Earlier, dealers had belived that Suez would bid for Lyonnaise in order not to lose out on nine billion francs in carry-forward fiscal losses.
